implemented: One active/uncertain/succeeded package slot enforced by database uniqueness and package row locks.
Idempotent native-user request keys with immutable connection/package/payload-hash binding.
Worker fencing and one dispatch transition; package/product/service SHA-256 snapshot checked before dispatch.
Predispatch expiry/cancellation; dispatched/unknown cannot be cancelled or blindly retried.
Trusted-worker confirmation retains provider IDs as strings and records append-only state events.
No duplicate success event on identical completion replay; conflicting completion rejected.
advisor_notes: Existing WARN/ERROR counts unchanged and no new unindexed foreign keys.
Two intentional private RLS-without-policy informational findings; all direct client/service table grants revoked.
Three new unused-index informational findings retained; these protect and index the future lifecycle.
limitations: Internal broker is service-only and requires a verified native organization administrator. No live Edge/provider path calls it yet.
State tests use synthetic provider evidence, not actual Shopify responses; real same-connection response validation/reconciliation remains pending.
No automatic release of unknown requests; administrative recovery and real provider matching must be implemented before activation.
Payload-hash/source-snapshot binding does not replace currency, tax/discount, variant/customer mapping or credential/scope verification.
No simultaneous multi-session stress test performed; sequential retries and database uniqueness guards were verified.
